gen-audiowide-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Futuristic in a tile-by-tile way, Audiowide sets its tall lowercase in wide, boxy glyphs. Pilcrow Rounded follows with tight spacing and big open counters, so a long passage feels soft and warm.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-new-tegomin: Inviting and a bit casual, Chubbo draws its heading as if with a marker tip, every bend smooth. And New Tegomin, with its wide ring of a c, brings a dignified, traditional note beneath.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-biz-udmincho: Oswald packs its confident, strong letters into tightly knit rows that hit hard on the page. BIZ UDMincho does the quieter job, a bookish serif with shallow curls.
gen-eater-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads clean, its curves never crowding their own endings. Eater brings the dark, aggressive bite in a flat-brush heading, while the body keeps every diagonal as stout as its uprights.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-nunito: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister writes its heading in a marker-like line with ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Nunito does the gentler work, with big round bowls.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-quicksand: Revalia stretches out a relaxed stride of widely separated letters, its lowercase g left open below. And Quicksand makes the pair memorable, its bowls like blown glass bulbs and bars of identical thickness.
gen-almendra-display-mulish: Ornate and bookish at a glance, Almendra Display carries a pronounced x-height in its heading. And Mulish keeps a longer read easygoing, with one constant stroke width and open, horseshoe-like apertures.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes sturdy, large-looking words below Goldman. Over a longer passage its tall lowercase and clearly open e keep the text clean and steady, while Goldman's wide, commanding letters stay up top.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-nunito: Big lowercase, sharp attitude: Oxanium holds its monoline strokes at a constant thickness. But Nunito is where the softness lives, finishing its terminals well clear of the stem in big round bowls.
gen-irish-grover-fs-quicksand: Quicksand brings pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, with bowls like blown glass bulbs. Irish Grover's fun, organic heading is the real contrast, its stroke gently shifting.
